subject: Confidential: temporary manager swap — coverage playbook and approvals
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Confidential: temporary manager swap — coverage playbook and approvals

Team —

Heads up and asking for quick alignment: Rohan Mehta has a family leave window (Dec 20 — Jan 31) that was just finalized with People Ops. We need an approved short-term manager coverage plan that names an acting manager of record, defines review ownership for any January performance activities, and establishes an escalation path for production incidents.

Proposed coverage (do not share broadly):
- Acting manager of record: Vivek Kulkarni (Dec 20 — Jan 31)
- Weekly skip-levels / leadership sync: Laura Bennett will join the Platform Infra weekly leadership sync to keep customer-facing escalation continuity
- HR/comp tasks: Mina will coordinate the paperwork and compensation hold (if any) with Pinnacle HR

Attached are the coverage form and a draft handoff checklist — please review and reply with minor changes by EOD Thursday so I can route to Pinnacle HR and get DocuSign approvals. Aditya: please confirm you’re comfortable with the coverage decision operationally and whether we need a Sales/Customer escalation delegate for a critical account (Julie Owens / Acme Pharma).

Key asks:
- Vivek: confirm you can be acting manager and accept manager-of-record responsibilities (comp sign-off, approvals, termination authority if required)
- Laura: confirm availability for weekly escalation syncs and who from your org should be looped for customer continuity
- Aditya: confirm no outstanding sales escalations that need a separate delegate

This is confidential; keep distribution minimal while we finalize approvals.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: temporary-manager-coverage-form.pdf (application/pdf), handoff-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Confidential: temporary manager swap — coverage playbook and approvals

Camila —
Thanks for the clear plan. Operationally this is fine from my side as long as we have:

1) A named customer escalation delegate for the Acme Pharma relationship (Julie Owens). If Vivek will be the acting manager, who will be the primary contact for the account during that period?
2) Clarify whether Vivek will have temporary approval authority over quota/discount exceptions (we have an outstanding pricing exception in review). If not, we should designate an approvals proxy.

I don’t object to the coverage but want to avoid any last-minute ROP (risk-of-production) where customers see a gap. If needed I can loop in Julie myself this week to give heads-up.

–Aditya
VP, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

Camila / Aditya —
I can join the weekly leadership sync for continuity. A couple of items for the playbook to cover:

- Performance reviews: There are three direct reports on Rohan’s team with mid-January calibration notes. We need a clear owner for writing and submitting their review text (who signs off?).
- Budget/approvals: Please confirm whether Vivek is authorized to sign off on any discretionary headcount/contract spend up to $10k. If not, we should add a note about temporary approval flows.
- On-call/incident rotation: The infra on-call rota currently references Rohan. We need the schedule updated and the on-call escalation path documented before Dec 20.

If you want, I can take the review-drivers and draft a short section about performance sign-offs; will share a draft by Thursday morning.

Laura Bennett

Thanks Camila — I can serve as acting manager for the period specified. A few notes / requests before I confirm formally: 

1) Please assign a reduced direct-report list for the interim (I propose removing two projects where I’ll act as escalation-only; names below). I need to focus on critical operational SLAs and customer escalations.
2) Will need credential and admin access for the manager-of-record flows (Concur approvals, access to manager-level Slack channel, and People Ops manager dashboard).
3) Confirm whether I will be listed as the manager of record in Workday or as a ‘temporary delegate’ — this affects who PEO and payroll will talk to about benefits/leave.

I’m happy to take ownership on the performance write-ups if Camila and Laura want me to draft them; otherwise prefer that Laura own the review text and I provide comments.

I’ll mark Dec 20 — Jan 31 as blocked for manager duties in my calendar once HR and payroll confirm the flows.

—Vivek
Senior Engineering Manager (Platform)
Redwood Inference

Team — quick update and final approvals.

Pinnacle HR confirmed the temporary-delegate path (Workday designation as ‘interim delegate’) and has processed the paperwork. I’ve attached the signed DocuSign packet and the final coverage form. Summary of changes incorporated per thread:
- Vivek confirmed acting manager of record (Workday interim delegate) — access & Concur permissions will be provisioned by Monday.
- Laura will own performance write-ups for the three affected reports; Vivek will provide comments and final sign-off where appropriate.
- Aditya will be the customer escalation proxy for Acme Pharma for any pricing/contract exceptions; Julie Owens has been notified separately.
- On-call rota updated; ops has added the interim escalation phone list.

Next steps: Mina will close HR ticket HR-3421 and confirm that payroll and benefits note Vivek as interim delegate; I’ll post an internal note on Monday to the leadership channel with a redacted coverage summary for the org.

Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround on a sensitive change. Please keep this thread internal until I post the redacted note.

Camila Reyes
Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference
